sentences.text: 1 4. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the present applicant has been falsely implicated in the case as she has not committed any offence as alleged in the prosecution story.

Attention of the Court has been drawn towards Annexure No.4, which is an order dated 02.09.2021 passed by the Division Bench of this Court in Misc. Bench No.19269 of 2021, whereby the arrest of the present applicant was stayed and she was directed to cooperate in the investigation.
As per learned counsel for the applicant, present applicant has cooperated in the investigation and has not misused the protection so granted.
Learned counsel for the applicant has also submitted that charge sheet in the case has been filed on 14.03.2022.
Thereafter, the learned trial court has summoned the applicant.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that till date no warrant has been issued against the present applicant, inasmuch as, this fact has been considered by the learned Sessions Judge while rejecting the anticipatory bail application vide order dated 09.09.2024.
Present applicant being a lady may be granted anticipatory bail and she undertakes that she shall co-operate in the trial proceedings and shall not misuse the liberty of the anticipatory bail.

Learned counsel for the applicant next submitted that liberty of the present applicant may be protected in view of the dictum of the Hon'ble Apex Court in re; Sushila Aggarwal vs. State (NCT of Delhi), 2020 SCC online SC 98.
6.

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal vs. State (NCT of Delhi), 2020 SCC online SC 98
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail by submitting that the allegation against the present applicant is serious in nature.

On being confronted as to whether there is any allegation against the applicant that she had not cooperated in the investigation, after getting interim protection from the Division Bench of this Court, learned A.G.A. on the basis of instructions has informed the Court that there is no such allegation against the applicant.

7. Having considered the arguments of learned counsel for the parties and having perused the material available on record, without entering into the merits of the issue, considering the fact that present applicant is a lady, has been granted interim order by the Division Bench of this Court,
cooperated in the investigation and charge sheet has been filed and she has given her undertaking that she shall cooperate in the trial proceedings and shall not misuse the liberty of bail, if granted,
and also considering the fact that there is no flight risk, as the applicant is having her permanent address, I find it appropriate that liberty of the present applicant may be protected in view of the dictum of the Hon'ble Apex Court in re; Sushila Aggarwal vs. State (NCT of Delhi), 2020 SCC online SC 98.
8.

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal vs. State (NCT of Delhi), 2020 SCC online SC 98
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, it is directed that present applicant shall appear/surrender before the court concerned within a period of 15 days from today or on the date fixed, whichever is earlier, and shall produce/furnish two sureties of Rs.50,000/- and a personal bond of like amount along with her undertaking that she shall co-operate in the trial proceedings and shall not avoid those proceedings.
On completing such formalities, the court concerned shall release the applicant on anticipatory bail till conclusion of the trial.

9. In case the present applicant does not appear/surrender before the court concerned, in terms of the aforesaid order, the protection so given may be deemed to be withdrawn and any appropriate coercive order may be passed by the court concerned ensuring the presence of the present applicant.
